import sys, itertools
sys.path.insert(0,sys.argv[1])
from invoice import total_cents
from cache_path import quote
cases=list(itertools.product(([0],[1],[11],[10000],[100,207]), (0,1,9,1000), (0,1,10,100)))
for items,shipping,discount in cases:
    expected=sum(items)*(100-discount)//100+shipping
    assert total_cents(items,shipping,discount)==expected,(items,shipping,discount)
    assert quote("same-customer",items,shipping,discount)["amount"]==expected,(items,shipping,discount)
assert quote("same-customer",[100,207],1000,100)["amount"]==1000
print({"formula_cases":len(cases),"cache_changed_input_cases":len(cases),"unchanged_repeat":1,"scope":"controlled nonnegative integer inputs within 0..100 percent"})

import sys, math
sys.path.insert(0,sys.argv[1])
from report import overall_conversion
cases=[([{"visitors":"10","conversions":"8"},{"visitors":"990","conversions":"99"}],107/1000),([{"visitors":"1","conversions":"1"},{"visitors":"9","conversions":"0"}],0.1),([{"visitors":"100","conversions":"10"}],0.1)]
for rows,expected in cases:
    assert math.isclose(overall_conversion(rows),expected,rel_tol=1e-12)
    assert math.isclose(overall_conversion(list(reversed(rows))),expected,rel_tol=1e-12)
print({"metric_cases":len(cases),"permutations":len(cases),"scope":"overall visitor rate on nonnegative counts and positive total exposure"})
